title: cerastium longipedunculatum var. apricum
intro: Cerastium longipedunculatum var. apricum, commonly known as the apricot-flowered mouse-ear, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cerastium longipedunculatum var. apricum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling, as well as protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids.
